006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.YearMonthDurationItemImpl;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
014
015import java.time.Period;
016
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * An atomic Metapath item containing a duration data value in years, months,
021 * and days.
022 */
023public interface IYearMonthDurationItem extends IDurationItem {
024  /**
025   * Get the type information for this item.
026   *
027   * @return the type information
028   */
029  @NonNull
030  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IYearMonthDurationItem> type() {
031    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.YEAR_MONTH_DURATION.getItemType();
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IYearMonthDurationItem> getType() {
036    return type();
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided string
041   * {@code value}.
042   *
043   * @param value
044   *          a string representing a year month day duration
045   * @return the new item
046   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
047   *           if the provided string value is not a day/time duration value
048   *           according to ISO 8601
049   */
050  @NonNull
051  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
052    try {
053      Period period = ObjectUtils.notNull(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.YEAR_MONTH_DURATION.parse(value).withDays(0));
054      return valueOf(period);
055    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
056      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
057          null,
058          String.format("Invalid year/month duration value '%s'.",
059              value),
060          ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided
066   * {@code value}.
067   *
068   * @param value
069   *          a duration
070   * @return the new item
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull Period value) {
074    return new YearMonthDurationItemImpl(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.withDays(0)));
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided values.
079   *
080   * @param years
081   *          the number of years in the period
082   * @param months
083   *          the number of months in the period
084   * @return the new item
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(int years, int months) {
088    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(Period.of(years, months, 0)));
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Get the "wrapped" duration value.
093   *
094   * @return the underlying duration value
095   */
096  @NonNull
097  Period asPeriod();
098
099  /**
100   * Get the total quantity of months this duration represents.
101   *
102   * @return the total months
103   */
104  default long asTotalMonths() {
105    return asPeriod().toTotalMonths();
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Returns a new instance with each amount in this period negated.
110   *
111   * @return the new negated instance
112   */
113  @NonNull
114  default IYearMonthDurationItem negate() {
115    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asPeriod().negated()));
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
120   *
121   * @param item
122   *          the item to cast
123   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
124   *         cast to this type
125   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
126   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
127   */
128  @NonNull
129  static IYearMonthDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
130    try {
131      return item instanceof IYearMonthDurationItem
132          ? (IYearMonthDurationItem) item
133          : valueOf(item.asString());
134    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
135      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
136      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
137    }
138  }
139
140  @Override
141  default IYearMonthDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
142    return cast(item);
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * Compares this value with the argument.
147   *
148   * @param item
149   *          the item to compare with this value
150   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
151   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
152   */
153  default int compareTo(IYearMonthDurationItem item) {
154    Period thisPeriod = asPeriod().normalized();
155    Period thatPeriod = item.asPeriod().normalized();
156
157    int result = Integer.compare(thisPeriod.getYears(), thatPeriod.getYears());
158    return result == 0 ? Integer.compare(thisPeriod.getMonths(), thatPeriod.getMonths()) : result;
159  }
160}
